name: Futaba Saki
source:
She's tsundere with a strong tsun part, which is actually caused by her scaredy-cat personality. Still, she acts as the class president, tennis club president and inter-human relations are her specialty. She's often relied on. Gets especially well along with [url=/c40162]Kanade[/url] who's her classmate. 

In the newly formed family, she's the mother's side daughter. Looked up to by her little step sister [url=/c40165]Yuiri[/url], she's slightly put off by it. And yet, she cherishes her cute little sister a lot.
